side_effects: deletes prior link on the target
invalidates: prior match or reference link on target
notes: Migration 034 original CHECK restricted link_type to match only; 035 drops and recreates the CHECK.

title: Continuity base must be a top-8 candidate; reference-images guard
summary: Selecting a base requires the frame to be among the top 8 ranked candidates for the shot's current location and direction. PUT reference-images for start rejects a payload whose continuity_base_frame entry does not match the selected base.
trigger: PUT continuity-base select; PUT reference-images start
precondition: candidate list from listCandidates (same branch, start frames approved or generated)
invalidates: selected base cleared when base entry removed from reference payload
preserves: selection survives location change until user acts (candidate check is not repeated at generation)
ui_signal: 400 toast 'Selected frame is not a valid continuity base for this shot'
notes: Generation (fetchShotReferenceImageContext) does not recheck location or status beyond image and approved or generated status.

title: Manual location assignments are not auto-overwritten
summary: A shot whose location_match_source is manual is skipped by setting and direction re-resolution and by resolve-locations with preserveManual. Camera-direction assignment still refuses to switch a manual shot to a different location (409).

flags.tested: Y: shotLocationRoutes manual and direction tests

trigger: PUT shot setting or camera_direction_id; resolve-locations; PUT camera-direction
notes: Generic PUT shot does not check that camera_direction_id is a direction in the branch (projects.ts:L2421-L2426).

title: Camera direction assignment moves the shot to the direction's location
summary: Assigning a direction through the repair endpoint sets location to the direction's parent location with confidence 1 and source camera_direction_parent, unless already the same location.
trigger: PUT camera-direction with cameraDirectionId
precondition: direction view_type direction; parent asset location in branch
preserves: location when already same; manual conflicts return 409
ui_signal: coverage panel recomputed; Stage 7 badge Direction
notes: Generic PUT shot with camera_direction_id does not perform this location move; it resolves from text only.

title: Scene continuity risk rules (computed)
summary: Scene 1 is safe. Prior scene not video_complete gives risky. Any stage 1-4 state created after scene.updated_at gives broken. Scene status continuity_broken or outdated gives broken. Rule order is 1, 2, 3, 4 with early return.
trigger: every GET scenes
precondition: scenes and stage_states of active branch
notes: Rule 2 and rule 3 are reachable only once prior scene has video_complete, which only videoGenerationService sets.

title: Coverage groups shots by canonical location only
summary: Coverage counts shots only under their location_asset_id. Shots without a location, or whose location is not among the relevant set, go to unresolvedShots. Direction views are only matched within the same location.

flags.tested: Y: locationCoverageService.test.ts groups shots only by canonical location_asset_id

trigger: GET location-coverage
precondition: shot location resolution is from persisted location_asset_id
notes: direction_location_mismatch branch is unreachable because views are pre-grouped by location.

title: One continuity-typed reference entry per column
summary: add-frame-as-reference, chain-from-end-frame and copy-frame replace any existing type continuity entry in the target reference column rather than appending. Continuity-base entries use referenceRole continuity_base_frame and are separate.
trigger: add-frame-as-reference; chain-from-end-frame (dead); copy-frame to start
side_effects: removes prior continuity entry from start or end column
preserves: other entries and continuity_base_frame entries (copy-frame filters type continuity only)
notes: Type-based match: a manually uploaded reference with type continuity would also be removed.

title: Location warnings never block shot list lock
summary: Unresolved, ambiguous and scene-mismatch location counts add a warning only. The lock returns 409 with canForce true unless force is passed.
trigger: POST shots/lock
ui_signal: warning list in lock dialog (UNKNOWN exact UI)
notes: Stage 10 strict continuity validation (V1) is a separate blocking check.

title: Resolver constants and decision rules
summary: MIN_CANDIDATE_CONFIDENCE 0.56; DEFAULT_LOCATION_AUTO_APPLY_CONFIDENCE 0.72; AMBIGUITY_CONFIDENCE_DELTA 0.06. Exact name 0.99, containment 0.93 multi-word or 0.88 single, alias exact 0.97, alias containment 0.90 or 0.84, fuzzy 0.55 plus 0.26 coverage plus 0.16 jaccard. Camera direction parent is always 1.
notes: Asset description field is loaded but not used in scoring. Aliases are stored as JSONB array on project_assets.

title: Coverage strength rules (verbatim logic)
summary: Location strength: no shots gives usable if any reference else missing; all shots matched gives strong; no reference gives missing; any missing-image or mismatch gives weak; any fallback gives weak in advanced and usable in basic; otherwise weak. Response strength: any unresolved gives weak; no locations gives missing; all strong gives strong; any weak or missing gives weak; else usable.

flags.tested: P: 3 tests, no strength matrix test

notes: Frontend maps strong to Strong, usable to Fallback, weak to Needs repair, missing to Missing.

title: Shot location state transitions on re-resolution produce null links
summary: When a non-manual shot is re-resolved and the result is ambiguous or below 0.72, location_asset_id is set to null, so a prior automatic link is erased while source and notes change.
notes: toShotLocationPatch returns null for location_asset_id when shouldApply is false.

title: Scene risk upstream source is every stage 1-4 state row
summary: Rule 3 reads all stage_states rows for stages 1 to 4 of the active branch, all versions, and compares the max created_at with scene.updated_at. Scene updated_at changes on any scene edit.
notes: Stage 1-4 edits are not scene-specific, so every scene becomes broken after any upstream edit.

title: Two location-state classifiers with different thresholds
summary: Route classifier: resolved when source is manual or confidence at least 0.72, else suggested; ambiguous and unresolved from resolver. Composition classifier: suggested when confidence below 0.8, else resolved; never ambiguous.
notes: Shot at confidence 0.75 is resolved in Stage 7 and suggested in Stage 9.

title: matchShotToLocationView scoring used by generation references
summary: Assigned direction is used directly if it belongs to the location list. Otherwise score height match +2, distance +1, alias word of 3 or more chars found in action or setting +3; zero score falls back to primary or first direction. location_reference_strategy chosen from matched image presence.
notes: hasAssignedDirection uses shot.camera_direction_id even when it belongs to another location, so the main-direction role is applied to a view of a different location.

title: Preview manifest differs from generation references
summary: Preview (continuity-preview) computes a new manifest from DB state with shot-scoped assets and no transformation-event overrides. Generation uses persisted reference_image_order, which generate-prompts overwrote with its own loader including transformation overrides and unordered location views. Stage 10 edits are not in the preview.

flags.tested: P: parity tests fixture persisted order, so parity is by construction

notes: Unordered location_views query in generate-prompts (projects.ts L3646-L3651 area) affects directions[0] fallback choice.

title: Preview instructions and providerReady outputs are unused
summary: framePromptInstructions, continuityPromptInstructions, providerReadyReferences, persistedStartFrameManifest and persistedEndFrameManifest are computed by buildGenerationPackage but no caller outside service and tests reads them. The continuityPreview route returns them inside packages.

flags.functional: N: not consumed by image generation
flags.tested: Y: parity tests use persisted manifest only

notes: Frontend types declare persistedStartFrameManifest as GenerationReferenceManifestEntry[] while backend returns ReferenceImageOrderEntry-shaped data.

title: available-references content and ordering
summary: Options per scene instance in fixed order: scene instance image, master image if different, confirmed transformation post images, angle variants with image (no status filter). Location views, frames and continuity entries are excluded. Popover matches by upper-cased asset name, so continuity entries never match.

flags.functional: P: continuity-type refs show indefinite spinner

notes: No ranking exists; the shotId path param is unused.

title: batch-link-copy overwrites start frames without confirmation
summary: For each shot after the first, sets start_continuity match and overwrites the start frame image with the previous end frame image even when the start frame is approved. Creates match links and zero-cost job rows.
notes: Only generated or approved end frames are used as source.

title: Authorization gaps on continuity routes (service-role client)
summary: All backend queries use the service-role client, which bypasses RLS. Several owned routes check project ownership but not that the scene or shot belongs to that project, or that source frames belong to the project. DELETE frame-links deletes any link id.
notes: Reported as fact only; not a recommendation.

title: Location match events are write-only
summary: location_match_events rows are inserted by recordMatchEvent for every resolver application path and the backfill script. No code in backend or frontend reads the table, so its calibration use is UNKNOWN.
notes: Insert failure is only a console.warn.

title: shots location and camera columns
summary: location_asset_id FK to project_assets SET NULL; location_match_confidence NUMERIC(4,3) 0..1; location_match_source with 7 allowed values; location_match_notes; camera_distance, camera_height, camera_movement, camera_direction_id FK to location_views SET NULL.
notes: Migration 039 notes end_frame_reference_image_order was created in code without migration, added as compatibility fix.

title: location_views as direction and establishing inventory
summary: Views per location asset with view_type establishing or direction, camera metadata, image_key_url, is_primary, source user, established or stage7_inferred, provenance fields, sort_order, UNIQUE(project_asset_id, name). promoted_from_frame_id added in mig 040.

flags.tested: P: via coverage and route tests

notes: camera_distance and camera_height CHECK values are wide, medium, close and eye_level, high_angle, low_angle, overhead, ground_level.

title: location_match_events (audit)
summary: Audit rows per resolver run: raw_setting, scene_expected_location, camera_direction_id, result asset (only when applied), confidence, source, reason, ambiguity, applied flag, candidates JSONB array.
notes: RLS policies exist for SELECT and INSERT only.

title: frames lineage columns and frame_links
summary: frames.generated_from_frame_id, continuity_base_role CHECK five values, promoted_to_view_id. frame_links with link_type match or reference, unique target_frame_id, cascade on frame delete.
notes: Migration 034 RLS policies allow only the source frame owner; backend bypasses RLS.

title: project_assets.location_aliases
summary: JSONB array of alias strings with CHECK jsonb_typeof array and GIN index for location assets. Read by resolver. Written by project asset PUT only; no frontend control found.
notes: Alias editing UI UNKNOWN; search of src found only type declarations.

title: projects.continuity_mode
summary: TEXT NOT NULL default basic, CHECK basic or advanced. Written by V1 PUT route and read by coverage mode query fallback and V1 metrics.
notes: Coverage uses the query param mode, not this column.

title: Canonical location (project_assets with asset_type location)
summary: The identity every shot points to via location_asset_id. Owns location_views, aliases, scene_asset_instances rows, and is the basis for coverage grouping, continuity base matching and generation references.
notes: Location names are read from branch-scoped project_assets only.

title: Camera direction (location_view row with view_type direction)
summary: A view of a location with camera distance and height and optional alias. shots.camera_direction_id points to it. Location of the shot is derived from it when assigned via camera-direction route.
notes: Establishing views share the same table but are never chosen as camera direction by the route.

title: Continuity base candidate
summary: A start frame (status approved or generated, image non-null) from any shot in the branch at the same canonical location, with suitability tier, confidence, reason and status. Transient, not stored; the selected one is referenced by frame id.
notes: Status missing tier is declared but never produced.

title: Generation reference manifest entry
summary: Entry describing one generation reference: id, label, asset name, url, asset type, semantic role (location_direction_main, location_establishing_context, location_asset_fallback, continuity_base_frame, character_identity, prop_identity, style_reference, manual_reference, and others), provider role identity or style, reason, source. Exists in persisted reference arrays and preview.
notes: Frontend role union checked by name only; exhaustive comparison not done.

title: Frame link
summary: Directed link between a source frame and a target frame (match copy or one-shot reference). Surfaced to UI as continuityLink with linkType and role, and a human label from the other shot's shotId.
notes: Cross-scene links surface only for adjacent scene frames.

title: Continuity package and shot preview (computed)
summary: Output of buildGenerationPackage: shot id, strength, generation mode, reference manifest, fallback chain, adaptation notes, risk notices, location state, direction, selected and candidate bases, debug metadata. Never stored.

flags.functional: P: preview consumed by UI, instruction fields unused

notes: Frontend ShotContinuityPreview typing matches backend preview shape.

title: GET /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/continuity-preview
summary: Builds per-shot generation packages from scene assets, branch start frames candidates, shot assignments and selected bases. Read-only.
notes: Scene lookup filters by active branch. locationImageById is passed but never read by the service.

title: GET /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/location-coverage
summary: Read-only Stage 8 coverage. Query mode basic or advanced.
notes: Fetches scene asset instances without branch scoping on scene_asset_instances (scoped by scene id).

title: POST /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/shots/resolve-locations
summary: Runs resolver over scene shots; dry run by default, apply writes changed location fields and match events. Validates threshold 0 to 1.
notes: Returns shots and locationValidation.

title: PUT /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/location
summary: Manual assign or clear of canonical location (source manual).
notes: Does not check camera_direction_id consistency.

title: PUT /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/camera-direction
summary: Assigns or clears camera direction; assignment can move shot location to parent; 409 on manual conflict.
notes: Returns transformed shot with location state.

title: PUT /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/reference-images
summary: Stores start or end reference array. For start, rejects mismatched continuity base entry (400) and clears selection when base entry removed.
notes: Does not verify scene in active branch and does not validate urls.

title: PUT /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/continuity-base
summary: Select or clear reuse-edit base for a shot.
notes: Scene is verified in active branch; shot is verified in scene.

title: GET /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/available-references
summary: Returns grouped alternative images per scene asset for the reference popover.
notes: shotId unused.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/chain-from-end-frame
summary: Prepends a continuity reference with the given end frame url to reference_image_order. No frame_link.

flags.functional: P: writes column but no UI

notes: Frontend client method exists with no caller.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/add-frame-as-reference
summary: Adds a continuity reference from a source frame to start or end column; creates reference link; sets camera_change for start.
notes: Does not verify source frame belongs to project.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/copy-frame
summary: Copies a generated or approved frame into target start or end frame with zero-cost job and match link; removes continuity reference entries.
notes: Source frame ownership not checked beyond project check.

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/batch-link-copy
summary: Sets match mode on shots 2 to n and copies previous end frames into start frames with match links.
notes: Per-shot sequential queries (see V7-PRESSURE-02).

title: POST /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/generate-continuity-prompt
summary: Generates recomposition prompt for a shot (index greater than 0) via text LLM and stores continuity_frame_prompt.
notes: Also loads style capsule with try and catch that swallows errors.

title: DELETE /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/frame-links/:linkId
summary: Deletes frame_links row by id after project ownership check.
notes: Link id not scoped to scene.

title: Branch-wide start-frame scan on every continuity preview
summary: Continuity preview and continuity-base select fetch every approved or generated start frame in the branch with nested shots and scenes joins, no limit, then rank in memory. Batch ranking runs once per request, not per shot.
notes: Cost scales with branch frame count. Stage 10 polls only frames, but preview is refetched on mount and after mutations.

title: Repeated location context loads and per-shot writes
summary: Shot GET, PUT and camera-direction handlers reload full location context (all branch location assets and views) and re-run the resolver per shot. batch-link-copy issues several sequential queries per shot and propagateFrameLinks issues one update per target.
notes: Counts only; no timing measured.

title: Orphaned and dead continuity code paths
summary: chain-from-end-frame route and frameService.chainFromEndFrame have no UI caller. Stage 10 updateContinuityMutation is declared with optimistic updates but never called. direction_location_mismatch coverage branch is unreachable. locationStateFromShot candidates always empty array.
notes: Grep of src found no callers of chainFromEndFrame or updateContinuityMutation.mutate.

title: continuity_frame_prompt is never read by generation
summary: Stored recomposition prompt is written by generate-continuity-prompt and camera-change generation, but image generation builds its own prompt. UI help text claims it is used.
notes: Only display and copy in UI.

title: Preview-only generation package outputs
summary: framePromptInstructions, continuityPromptInstructions, providerReadyReferences, persisted manifests and debugMetadata are returned by the preview but unused by any consumer.
notes: Only tests reference them.

title: Write-only and unused backend fields
summary: location_match_events has no reader. locationImageById parameter to continuityComposition is accepted but never read. ContinuityBaseCandidate missing tier never produced. location_match_source value ambiguous used in metrics and not allowed by CHECK.
notes: ambiguousBaselineLocations counter always 0 (V1 metrics).

title: continuityBaseService tier, ranking and batch tests
summary: Covers tier assignment, bonuses capped at 1, exclusions, sort order, limit, batch single query, pickCandidateById.
notes: Does not test missing tier.

title: continuityCompositionService base and parity tests
summary: Verifies base placed first and reuse_edit mode, and preview-vs-generation reference sequence parity using a fixture of the persisted manifest (by construction).
notes: Parity holds only because the test feeds the preview output back as the persisted state.

title: continuityRiskAnalyzer rule tests
summary: Covers Rules 1 to 4, priority, class instance, and timestamp edge cases.
notes: Pure function tests, no DB.

title: locationCoverageService tests (3)
summary: Grouping by canonical location id, advanced severity for unresolved direction, flagged missing image for repair. No test for mismatch, strength matrix or response strength.

title: locationResolverService tests (6)
summary: Normalization of screenplay headings, exact name, alias, camera direction parent precedence, ambiguity not auto-applied, scene expected-location fallback.
notes: Fuzzy-only path not directly tested.

title: shotLocationRoutes integration tests (5)
summary: Shot PUT re-resolution, manual assign, batch apply preserving manual, Stage 8 coverage route, camera-direction assign.

title: continuity base, mode and metrics route tests
summary: continuity-base select, clear, 400 invalid candidate, 404s; continuity-mode get, put, default; continuity-metrics totals and strict issues (V1 metrics).

title: referenceContinuity route tests
summary: add-frame-as-reference validation and link creation, start_continuity camera_change for start only, copy-frame mutual exclusivity cleanup, 401 checks.

title: ContinuityBaseChooser component tests (5)
summary: Loading state, empty state, ranked candidates with onSelect, selected base Using and onClear Fresh, disabled during update.
notes: Does not test the 'Fresh generation' display when persisted base is outside the top 8.

title: Provider wiring for continuity text and vision calls
summary: Text prompts go through llm-client (LangChain ChatGoogleGenerativeAI, env GEMINI_MODEL, LangSmith tracing). Reference vision uses @google/generative-ai with hard-coded gemini-2.5-flash. Image generation provider is outside this slice.
notes: llm-client requires GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_API_KEY at construction.
